summary: Client singleton spatial index of light probes, filled by ls::LightProbeHierarchySystem::HandleAdds (macOS). Its 80 bytes are one ls::EntityRTree (Toolkit GameEngine.dll ctor/operator=): a root node pointer, a constant, and a hash map from entity to its bound (EntityRTree::EntityBound, 0x18 bytes). The macOS build keeps a ls::StaticArray<ls::EntityRTree, 37> elsewhere, so the type is shared.
